messages.content:
You are a helpful assistant that helps users with normal chat, and helps users book flights for vactions.
The required user inputs are destination_city, arrival_city, date, and carrier preference. Today's date is 2024-03-02 in yyyy-mm-dd format.
Use tools appropriately to get user inputs. Get the user preference one by one in that order if the user hasn't given already.
Use the function `text_to_speech` to give a text-to-speech input to the user to play some audio to ask questions to the user and then render a ui form based on the question.
Use the function `render_ui_multi_select_widget` to create a form to show famous flight / train / cab carriers/options in India (maximum 4).
Use the function `render_ui_single_select_widget` to create a form to accept location preference.
Use `render_ui_date_picker_widget` to render date picker component and get the required date.
When all the above information is present to call the function `google_flights_api_tool` and get the search for the flights.
After getting output from `google_flights_api_tool`, call the  `render_ui_finish` function to render the final card to show the list of flights available
Hello! Can you assist me in scheduling a flight with IndiGo airlines?

function.name: render_ui_single_select_widget
function.description: Renders a single-select UI widget with a provided heading and a set of options from which the user can select one. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

heading.description: The text displayed as the heading of the single-select widget.

options.description: An array of strings representing the selectable options in the widget.

default_option.description: The option that is selected by default. Must be one of the provided options.

function.name: render_ui_multi_select_widget
function.description: Renders a multi-select UI widget with a specified heading and a list of selectable options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

heading.description: The text displayed as the heading of the multi-select widget.

options.description: An array of strings representing the selectable options within the widget.

default_selection.description: An array of strings representing the default selected options in the widget.

enabled.description: A flag to indicate whether the multi-select widget is enabled or disabled.

function.name: render_ui_date_picker_widget
function.description: Renders a date-picker widget allowing the user to select a single date, with the option to set a default date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

default_date.description: The pre-selected default date for the date-picker. The date format should be 'dd-mm-yyyy', for example, '15-04-2023'.

function.name: render_tts
function.description: Converts a given text message into speech to provide auditory instructions or ask questions to the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

tts.description: The text message to be converted into speech.

language.description: The language in which the text message is to be spoken.

volume.description: The volume level for the speech, ranging from 0.0 (silent) to 1.0 (maximum volume). This is a float type value.

speed.description: The speed at which the text is spoken, ranging from 0.5 (half speed) to 2.0 (double speed). This is a float type value.

function.name: render_ui_finish
function.description: This function prepares and displays the final list of available flight options to the user based on the gathered information. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

default_date.description: The default date to be displayed in the date-picker component. The expected format is 'dd-mm-yyyy', such as '15-04-2023'.
